findings.finding: 'Exactly one new file under smoke/' and 'no other path differs from main' are not machine-checkable on a shared base siblings move (LEGSMOKE-1016 note records the drift).
findings.answer: C1 judges the diff this issue owns: legionDiff from the fork point 6d843f28 at each head and mergeParentCheck at the merge; the pre-state is written as invalidating facts (404 at ref=main, commitsByPath [], no PR, required set [gate]), never main == 6d843f28, and a moved main@origin is never a stop.

findings.finding: 'No other path differs' collides with retro's docs/solutions notes and the .legion/ handoffs that must exist on the branch before retro removes them.
findings.answer: D2 allows zero or more docs/solutions/legion/*-LEGSMOKE-1081.md notes (expected none) in the acceptance path set; handoffPaths at the head READY names must be [] (READY refuses a head still carrying handoffs); C1 checks both.

findings.finding: The rehearsal's constraint is unplanned-for: a committed-but-unpushed handoff, PUSH_READY, then a wait across a daemon upgrade; a successor must know where the commit is and what to re-check.
findings.answer: The rehearsal record (plan.md section and plan.json rehearsal) names the expected local state (@- with plan.json, trailer already applied, bookmark unmoved), the pre-push re-checks (identity, remote still 6d843f28, no PR, 404 at ref=main), the push and completion commands, and the resting state if stopped; every constant lives in the plan.

findings.finding: 'Do not push and do not call handoff_complete' has two readings: suppress only those two, or suppress everything that leaves the pane.
findings.answer: Reading chosen and recorded: only the push and handoff_complete wait; plan.md is uploaded to Dispatch and the in-pane plan-reviewer runs before PUSH_READY (it is a subagent, not a Dispatch approval request); the reply is exactly PUSH_READY.

findings.finding: The required check gate lives in fail-on-demand.yml (exit 1 iff a root .fail-me exists), not ci.yml; no root .gitignore, so a stray scratch file would be snapshotted and redden gate for every tree.
findings.answer: Constants name gate = fail-on-demand.yml (required) and check = ci.yml (advisory); every role works in mktemp -d and creates no file inside the workspace; the required-check control is gateControl (mergeStateStatus BLOCKED at a trailered head with zero check-runs), never a .fail-me probe.

findings.finding: The hash constants and the blob-method verification were unverified by the analyst.
findings.answer: Constants carry the exact command that re-derives each value (printf | sha256sum; blob header | sha1sum) and the verification against smoke/LEGSMOKE-1070.md's GitHub sha 350a26d9 observed 18:23Z; implementer task 4 re-derives them from the pushed bytes before they are used as proof; the L2 values are marked example-only.

findings.finding: The production check has no definition for a repository with no runtime or deploy; pending and fail are undefined.
findings.answer: productionCheck defines pass, pending and fail as concrete reads at ref=mergeSha and ref=main (readCommand, listOnMain, commitsByPath, mergeParentCheck, checkRuns), and implementer task 8 rewrites the Production: line and posts one footer comment.

findings.finding: The CI criterion names no SHA or run; each push to a branch with an open PR yields a push run and a pull_request run per job; trailered heads carry no check-runs.
